name: voice-fixups
description: Custom vocabulary for dictated prompts: replaces spoken phrases ("cube cuttle") with what you meant ("kubectl"), whole words, any case

replacements.title: Replacements
replacements.description: One per entry as "spoken => written" (e.g. "cube cuttle => kubectl"). ~/.claude/voice-fixups.json and the project's .claude/voice-fixups.json add to these and win on the same phrase.
